def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    dots = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
            if grid[r][c] not in (6, 9)]
    for r, c, color in dots:
        out[r][c] = 4
        # Extend from the dot toward the nearest edge marker on its row.
        for dc in (-1, 1):
            cc = c + dc
            while 0 <= cc < w and grid[r][cc] != 9:
                out[r][cc] = color
                cc += dc
    return out
